headline: Independent Media Trust discloses substantial acquisition in Network18 under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Independent Media Trust filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) signalling a material shareholding acquisition in Network18 Media & Investments Limited, triggering takeover code compliance.
detail: Independent Media Trust submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 22 June 2026, reporting a substantial acquisition in Network18. Under SEBI's Takeover Code, acquisition of 25% or more triggers a mandatory open offer; acquisition of 5% or more requires public disclosure. The filing is the first formal notice to the market of IMT's shareholding movement, and will be followed by a detailed disclosure statement (if open offer is triggered) or a standstill undertaking (if exempt). This is a key regulatory gate for media sector consolidation in India.
